qa.heat_rule: confidence >= 60; per-theme each stock counted once. Cross-theme capital duplication must be handled by normalized theme metrics, not by summing themes into a market total.

補齊PCB上游玻纖布、FCCL、焊錫等材料鏈。

fill_holes_v2_0.BBU: 補至4檔，首次達到Top 5題材排名的最低成分股數門檻。
fill_holes_v2_0.policy: 後續優先補2-3檔的高價值Theme，不為了數量新增大量新Theme。

qa.v2_1_focus: 優先加厚先進封裝設備/材料與機器人系統整合；新增標籤採保守 purity，避免把試樣/布局當成主要營收。

design_principles: 同一股票在同一題材只計一次。
跨題材允許重疊，但題材分數使用標準化指標，不把各題材成交金額加總成市場總額。
confidence < 60 的標籤不參與題材分數。
A/B/C/D 與 purity/confidence 僅作權重，不直接取代價格、量能與 VCP 訊號。
Heat 與 Setup 分開：Heat 看已發生的資金與廣度，Setup 看尚未突破但型態正在集中。

components.money_flow_relative: 題材成分股『今日成交額 / 20日平均成交額』的加權中位數與上四分位數，避免單一大型權值股主導。
components.breadth: 加權上漲家數比例；建議以漲幅 > 0 為基礎，另可觀察 >2% 的強勢廣度。
components.volume_expansion: 量比 >1.5、>2.0 的成分股占比與加權平均量比。
components.price_strength: 成分股相對大盤/產業的當日相對強弱，建議用加權中位數而非平均。
components.vcp_breakout_activity: 今日突破 Pivot、帶量突破、新進突破等 VCP 事件的加權比例。
components.persistence: 近3日 Theme Heat 是否連續高於自身20日基準，避免一天煙火。

components.waiting_near_pivot: 位於 Pivot 下方約0-8%且尚未突破的股票占比；越集中越高。
components.vcp_quality: 題材內 VCP 綜合評分的加權中位數，優先看高關聯成分股。
components.volume_dryup: 收縮段量能乾涸比例；量能低於近期均量越明顯，分數越高。
components.new_candidates: 近1-3日『今日新進/等待』數量是否增加。
components.theme_early_flow: 資金開始轉強但尚未達 Heat 主線門檻，例如相對成交額上升、廣度改善。
components.breakout_penalty: 若題材內大量股票已突破並大漲，Setup 分數略扣，避免把已發動主線誤標為蓄勢。

notes: 少於4檔的題材仍可顯示，但不進 Top 5 排名。
任何單一股票對某題材分數的貢獻上限 25%。
台積電等大型權值股應以相對成交額與中位數方法處理，不用絕對成交額直接壓過其他成分。
可將『產業』與『題材』榜分開，避免官方產業與自建 Theme 混算。

ui_output_example.note: Heat 高、Setup 中等：題材已發動，優先找尚未突破但型態完整者。

normalization.clip: Each raw metric is clipped to sensible bounds before scaling.

examples.breadth: weighted fraction of members with returnPct > 0, directly *100
examples.volumeExpansion: blend of weighted median volumeRatio and fraction >=1.5
examples.vcpBreakoutActivity: weighted fraction breakout/volume_breakout, with volume_breakout bonus
examples.volumeDryup: for waiting stocks, contractionVolumeRatio <=0.65 scores high

ranking_rules.themeTop5: rank by Theme Heat; require >=4 constituents and effectiveWeight >=2
ranking_rules.setupTop5: rank by Setup Heat; require >=4 constituents and effectiveWeight >=2; latent themes are eligible even when Heat <45
ranking_rules.emerging: Setup >=70 AND Heat 45-74 AND nearPivotWeightedPct >=25 AND breakoutWeightedPct <35
ranking_rules.activeWithSetups: Heat >=75 AND Setup >=60 AND breadthPct >=45 AND nearPivotWeightedPct >=15
ranking_rules.taxonomy: Top 5 ranks canonical rankable themes only; raw subthemes/segments do not compete directly.

results.情境: 整個液冷族群同步升溫
健康主線且仍有待突破股

recommended_guardrail_patch.emerging_requires: Setup >= 70 AND 45 <= Heat < 75 AND nearPivotWeightedPct >= 25 AND breakoutWeightedPct < 35
recommended_guardrail_patch.active_with_setups_requires: Heat >= 75 AND Setup >= 60 AND breadthPct >= 45 AND nearPivotWeightedPct >= 15
recommended_guardrail_patch.reason: Prevents a single mega-cap or two speculative small caps from making a theme appear broadly hot.

test_conclusion.two_small_caps_spike: PASS because <4 constituents cannot enter Top 5; for larger themes breadth floor prevents false hot

policy.rankable_theme: 可獨立形成市場資金輪動、通常應有 >=4 個有效成分股。
policy.segment: 供應鏈角色/產品層，保留供個股與題材詳情使用，但不單獨進 Top 5。
policy.alias: 語意高度重疊的舊標籤，統一映射至 canonical theme。
policy.rule: Theme Heat Top 5 只對 rankable_theme 計分；segment 仍可用來找 strongest segment。

placement.desktop: 資金熱區卡片內，左側維持『產業 Top 5』，右側新增『題材 Top 5』；下方可切換『題材蓄勢』。
placement.mobile: 同一卡片內使用 segmented tabs：產業｜題材｜蓄勢，避免三組榜單同時擠在窄螢幕。

tabs.label: 👀 題材蓄勢
tabs.purpose: 找尚未全面發動的 VCP 題材

interaction.tap_theme: 展開 Bottom Sheet / detail panel，不直接跳離目前股票清單。
detail_sections: 題材狀態：Heat / Setup / 生命週期
interaction.tap_stock: 回到單股分析並保留來源題材，返回時回到原題材位置。
interaction.sort: Top 5 預設 Heat/Setup；詳細頁可切換 Heat、VCP評分、距Pivot、漲幅。

mobile_rules.do_not_show: Purity、Confidence、Grade 不在榜單主畫面顯示，避免資訊過載；放在題材詳細頁。
mobile_rules.score_display: Heat/Setup 使用整數，不顯示小數。
mobile_rules.colors: 沿用現有 VCPulse 色系；生命週期以 icon+文字為主，不只靠顏色區分。
mobile_rules.sticky_context: 從題材點進股票後，返回保留題材 tab、排序與 scroll position。

copy_rules.maintrend_setups: 主線已熱，仍有未突破 VCP
copy_rules.emerging: 資金開始改善，VCP 型態集中
copy_rules.latent: 資金未明顯升溫，但 VCP 正在靠近 Pivot
copy_rules.extended: 多數成分已突破，留意追價風險

integration_order: load current VCP scanner quote/status data
only after standalone verification, merge into V2.39

integrationTest.warning: 這是用 VCPulse runtime input shape 做的模擬資料，只驗證演算法/資料流，不代表 2026-09-10 真實 Heat 分數。

scoreCalibration.method: 7 scenario x 4,000 Monte Carlo aggregate-theme simulations; synthetic calibration, not market backtest.
scoreCalibration.reason: V2.5 showed Setup Heat structurally compressed. Public VCP definitions emphasize near-pivot tightness and volume dry-up, so Setup should reward those features without requiring strong current money flow.

recommended_lifecycle_thresholds.emerging: Setup >=70 AND Heat 45–64 AND nearPivot >=25 AND breakout <35
recommended_lifecycle_thresholds.maintrend_setups: Heat >=75 AND Setup >=65 AND breadth >=45 AND nearPivot >=15

guardrails: Do not treat this as historical validation.
Keep confidence<60 excluded and min 4 constituents/effectiveWeight>=2.
Before formal merge, run at least 20–40 real trading-day snapshots to estimate empirical percentiles.
If market-wide volatility changes sharply, percentile normalization may be superior to fixed thresholds.

alpha2_focus: cross-membership control between AI PCB and IC substrate

alpha15_unresolved.name: 兆赫
alpha15_unresolved.reason: 目前查到的可靠公開資料不足以確認具體LEO供應鏈角色、客戶、量產或營收曝險；不以概念股/影音說法補note。

memberships_removed.name: 兆赫
memberships_removed.reason: 多輪搜尋仍缺乏可驗證的LEO客戶、產品、量產或營收曝險；原membership低Purity，為避免概念股污染Rankable計分而移除。

alpha19_semantic_cleanup.principle: fix taxonomy when direct evidence contradicts old label; remove repeated weak concept-only memberships; keep scores frozen for separate calibration.

consistencyAudit.principle: batch research, same membership-detail standard as Alpha3–Alpha7

reasons: rankable but fewer than 2 high-purity/high-confidence members

scaleFairnessAuditAlpha20.principle: diagnostic only; do not normalize or change scores before historical/forward validation

validationBridgeAlpha21.purpose: Test whether static membership-weight scale causes some rankable themes to enter Theme/Setup Top5 more often independent of market conditions.
validationBridgeAlpha21.input: backtest_daily.json from existing historical runner (v0.3+ compatible)
tests: Correlation of avg static effective weight/member vs Top5 frequency
Pairwise boundary co-appearance for the three known overlap pairs

decision_rule.do_not_change_scores_if: Top5 frequency differences are not consistently aligned with static scale flags or sample is too short.
decision_rule.review_scores_if: High-scale themes repeatedly dominate Top5 frequency after eligible-day normalization and the association persists over >=20 trading days.

validationBridgeAlpha22.purpose: Test whether Theme Top5 selection has forward-return value beyond static membership scale.
validationBridgeAlpha22.signal: Theme Top5 on each historical day
validationBridgeAlpha22.control: Same-day eligible non-Top5 theme matched on static scale, constituent count and setup proximity; controls with >30% constituent overlap excluded.
rules: Only observations with enough future price bars are scored

validationBridgeAlpha23.purpose: Pre/Post event study around Theme Top5 entry to classify the signal as leading, synchronous, or lagging.
validationBridgeAlpha23.event: Theme enters Top5 after not being in Top5 on the previous valid trading day.
validationBridgeAlpha23.left_censor_rule: Do not count themes already in Top5 on the first historical day as fresh entries.
validationBridgeAlpha23.return_unit: equal-weight event-day active constituent close-to-close return, rebased to event day close
